cards.name: Table
cards.summary: Selects every cell of the table you are working in, so cell formatting (fill, borders, text attributes) applies to the whole table at once. Disabled unless a table is active: it was off with no document, an empty document, a rectangle or a bitmap selected.
cards.script_api: FrameWork.Automation.InvokeItem("a187e17d-1abb-4323-953c-544582d0a1ec"); object model: s.Custom.Select (s = the table Shape; TableShape.Select selects all its cells) (unverified)
use_for: restyle all borders of a price table in one go
give every cell of a spec table the same font size and fill
avoid: to move or scale the table as an object just pick it with the Pick tool; this command is for cell-level formatting

review.changes: script_api: replaced s.Custom.Cells.Range.Select (Cells.Range needs an IndexArray argument) with TableShape.Select, the harvested 'selects all the cells' member; summary: dropped the unproven 'active with the Table tool' condition, states the harvested disabled states instead

cards.name: Split into Columns
cards.summary: Splits the selected table cell(s) into the number of columns you type, dividing each cell's width evenly.
cards.how: Select one or more cells with the Table tool, run the command, enter the number of columns in the dialog, OK.
cards.script_api: FrameWork.Automation.InvokeItem("b60f4415-f47c-ad89-4b10-6df8487529b8") opens the dialog only; same job: cell.Split(NumColumns:=n, NumRows:=1) on each selected TableCell (unverified)
use_for: add sub-columns under a header cell in a comparison table
split a wide cell into price + unit
avoid: to get back cells that were merged earlier use Unmerge Cells rather than splitting

cards.name: Split into Rows
cards.summary: Splits the selected table cell(s) into the number of rows you type, dividing each cell's height evenly.
cards.how: Select one or more cells with the Table tool, run the command, enter the number of rows in the dialog, OK.
cards.script_api: FrameWork.Automation.InvokeItem("524b07d8-c0e8-e99d-47b9-05fe93aaf8d2") opens the dialog only; same job: cell.Split(NumColumns:=1, NumRows:=n) on each selected TableCell (unverified)
use_for: stack two lines of data (e.g. size and colour) inside one table row
add a sub-row under a category cell
avoid: to add a full new row across the table use the table's insert-row commands instead of splitting cells one by one

cards.name: Unmerge Cells
cards.summary: Breaks a merged table cell back into the separate cells it was merged from.
cards.script_api: FrameWork.Automation.InvokeItem("ca1afb09-08ba-41e4-8df1-13c12b2f0203"); object model: cellRange.Unmerge (or cell.Unmerge on a merged TableCell) (unverified)
use_for: undo a merged header when the table layout changes
restore a grid after a merged cell no longer fits the content
avoid: does nothing on a cell that was never merged; to divide an ordinary cell use Split into Columns / Split into Rows

cards.name: Align to Baseline
cards.summary: Moves characters that were shifted up or down (for example nudged with the Shape tool) back onto the text baseline, so the line reads straight again.
cards.script_api: FrameWork.Automation.InvokeItem("01f7dc01-59c2-4276-b3d8-53ce87046057"); object model: s.Text.Story.AlignToBaseline (unverified)
use_for: clean up a headline after nudging single letters with the Shape tool
reset a bouncing-letter title to a straight line
avoid: it also removes vertical shifts you set on purpose; reapply those afterwards

cards.name: Align to Baseline Grid
cards.summary: Toggle: makes the lines of the selected paragraph text snap to the document baseline grid, so lines in neighbouring columns and frames sit on the same horizontal lines.
cards.script_api: FrameWork.Automation.InvokeItem("38f80f45-c40e-22ad-4f80-393eca921633")
use_for: multi-column brochure where lines must line up across columns
magazine-style page built on a fixed leading grid
avoid: leading that is not a multiple of the grid spacing gets pushed to the next grid line and opens gaps; set the grid spacing to the body leading first

cards.name: Bullets and Numbering
cards.summary: Opens the Bullets and Numbering dialog to turn the selected paragraphs of paragraph text into a bulleted or numbered list.
cards.how: Select paragraph text (or some of its paragraphs), turn lists on, pick a bullet glyph and font or a numbering style, then set size, baseline shift, the indents from frame and from text, and whether the list hangs.
cards.script_api: FrameWork.Automation.InvokeItem("ed641ec9-27e4-46ea-b5ce-77778a163506") opens the dialog only; same job: s.Text.Story.ApplyBulletEffect(Symbol, Font, Size, BaselineShift, HorizontalPosition, HangingIndent) (unverified)
use_for: feature list on a flyer
numbered steps on an instruction sheet
avoid: works on paragraph text; convert artistic text first (Text > Convert, Ctrl+F8)

cards.name: Change Case
cards.summary: Opens the Change Case dialog and rewrites the selected text as Sentence case, lowercase, UPPERCASE, Title Case or tOGGLE cASE; the characters themselves change, not just how they display.
cards.how: Select a text object or characters in edit mode, pick one of the five case options, OK.
cards.script_api: FrameWork.Automation.InvokeItem("0e3eb2f9-7f5d-4033-bffd-ce71e5120b42") opens the dialog only; same job: s.Text.Story.ChangeCase(cdrTextSentenceCase | cdrTextLowerCase | cdrTextUpperCase | cdrTextTitleCase | cdrTextToggleCase) (unverified)
use_for: fix ALL-CAPS copy pasted from a client brief
set a headline in Title Case
avoid: it rewrites the source characters; to show capitals while keeping the original case use the font's All Caps / Small Caps attribute

cards.name: Columns
cards.summary: Opens Column Settings for paragraph text: splits the text frame into several columns with set widths and gutters.
cards.how: Set the number of columns, the width and gutter of each (or tick Equal column width), and choose whether the frame keeps its current width or adjusts automatically.
cards.script_api: FrameWork.Automation.InvokeItem("11acb7c1-3a92-4bc0-bbeb-6ab1e29f2f12") opens the dialog only; same job: s.Text.Frame.SetColumns(NumColumns, EqualColumns, WidthsAndGutters) (unverified)
use_for: two-column body text on an A4 newsletter
three-column panel of a brochure
avoid: paragraph text only; for text that jumps between separate boxes link frames instead of adding columns

cards.name: Convert
cards.summary: Converts the selected artistic text to paragraph text, or paragraph text to artistic text.
cards.script_api: FrameWork.Automation.InvokeItem("7f650d0c-1cca-49aa-a1fa-5d78c99e1c0b"); object model: s.Text.ConvertToParagraph / s.Text.ConvertToArtistic (unverified)
use_for: turn a pasted line into a paragraph frame so it wraps
turn a short paragraph-text label into artistic text that scales with the object
avoid: paragraph text that overflows its frame or runs through linked frames may not convert to artistic text; fit it into one frame first

cards.name: Drop Cap
cards.summary: Opens the Drop Cap dialog to enlarge the first letter of the selected paragraphs so it drops down a set number of lines.
cards.how: Tick Use drop cap, set the number of lines dropped and the space after the drop cap, optionally use the hanging-indent style; Preview, OK.
cards.script_api: FrameWork.Automation.InvokeItem("4349fb4c-7e3b-4f07-a820-203a56950820") opens the dialog only; same job: s.Text.Story.ApplyDropCapEffect(LinesDropped, DistanceFromText, HangingIndent) (unverified)
use_for: editorial opener of a magazine article
classic story start on a book jacket blurb
avoid: paragraph text only; for a decorative initial in another font or colour set it as separate artistic text and wrap the paragraph around it

cards.name: Edit Text
cards.summary: Opens the Edit Text dialog: the selected text object's content in a separate editing box with font, size and alignment controls, so you can retype it without zooming into the canvas.
cards.how: Select exactly one text object (or be editing text), run the command, edit in the box, OK commits the change.
cards.script_api: FrameWork.Automation.InvokeItem("d14b05d4-c787-4b98-b5d0-c31de84698d5") opens the dialog only; same job: s.Text.Story.Text = "new text" (unverified)
use_for: fix a typo in tiny or heavily transformed text
replace the wording of text fitted to a path or inside an envelope
avoid: for the same change across many objects use find and replace instead of editing each one

cards.name: Encode
cards.summary: Opens the Text Encoding dialog to choose which character encoding is used to read the selected text, to fix garbled characters in text made under another language or code page.
cards.how: Select the text object, pick the encoding the text was written in, check the preview until the characters read correctly, OK.
cards.script_api: FrameWork.Automation.InvokeItem("63992d01-3a67-4615-a7bd-214be3dbd7bc") opens the dialog only; closest object-model member: s.Text.Story.CharSet = cdrCharSetRussian (any cdrTextCharSet value; sets the character set of the range) (unverified)
use_for: repair garbled characters in text from an old non-Unicode file
fix Cyrillic or Asian text that shows as accented Latin symbols
avoid: it reinterprets the stored bytes, it does not translate; if the wrong characters were saved as Unicode, retype or re-import the text

review.changes: script_api: 'no object-model call is known' was wrong; added TextRange.CharSet (harvested, cdrTextCharSet enum) as the closest member

cards.name: Fit Text to Path
cards.summary: Puts text along a path: with a text object and a curve or shape selected it flows the text along the path; with only a path selected it places a text cursor on the path so you can type along it.
cards.how: Select the text, Shift-select the path, run the command; or select the path alone, run it and type. Adjust distance from path, side and offset on the property bar.
cards.script_api: FrameWork.Automation.InvokeItem("8c2ac89e-4b4a-41f9-bbad-4f38708a92c2") (may wait for interactive input); direct: s.Text.FitToPath(pathShape) (unverified)
use_for: curved logo text around a circular badge
text following a wavy ribbon
avoid: paths with tight corners make letters crowd or overlap; smooth the path or add letter spacing

cards.name: Glyphs
cards.summary: Opens or closes the Glyphs docker, which shows every character and OpenType alternate of a font so you can insert symbols, ligatures and special characters into text.
cards.script_api: FrameWork.Automation.InvokeItem("00c72ae6-404d-4ea9-4a32-c6c2d5ce078f")
use_for: insert copyright, registered or arrow symbols
pick a swash alternate for a script-font logo
avoid: for dashes and fixed spaces the Insert Formatting Code shortcuts are faster

cards.name: Column/Frame Break
cards.summary: Inserts a column/frame break at the text cursor in paragraph text, pushing the following text to the top of the next column or the next linked frame.
cards.script_api: s.Text.BeginEdit, place the cursor, then FrameWork.Automation.InvokeItem("cef94dde-0418-413c-a18f-7d4511003bc7") (enabled only in text edit mode; unverified)
use_for: start a new section at the top of the next column in a brochure
move a heading and its paragraph into the next linked frame
avoid: breaks stay where they are when copy changes; recheck them after edits
needs an active text cursor in paragraph text (Text tool editing); unlike the dash and space codes there is no plain character to type into a script string for it

review.changes: avoid: removed 'in a script put the character straight into the string' (no character code is known for a column/frame break); script_api: added Text.BeginEdit to reach the text-edit state the item's enable binding needs

cards.name: Custom Optional Hyphens
cards.summary: Opens a dialog for defining where chosen words may break with optional hyphens, so those words hyphenate the way you set wherever they occur in paragraph text.
cards.how: Enter the word, mark the allowed break points, add it to the list of custom definitions, OK.
cards.script_api: FrameWork.Automation.InvokeItem("217e7e25-d294-41e7-9e32-9fec70199724") opens the dialog only; no object-model call for this job is known
use_for: stop a brand name from being split at an ugly point
force correct breaks in long technical words
avoid: for a single occurrence just insert an Optional Hyphen (Ctrl+-) at the break point

cards.name: Em Dash
cards.summary: Inserts an em dash at the text cursor.
cards.script_api: FrameWork.Automation.InvokeItem("6b13bb31-6d4a-41f9-a74e-e22272216e5f") (text edit mode); object model: s.Text.Selection.InsertAfterWide ChrW(8212) (unverified)
use_for: set-off phrase in body copy
attribution line before a quote's author
avoid: needs an active text cursor (Text tool editing); in a script put the character straight into the string

review.changes: script_api: InsertAfter -> InsertAfterWide (the harvested Unicode variant; fixed spaces and the non-breaking hyphen are outside the ANSI code page InsertAfter works in)

cards.name: Em Space
cards.summary: Inserts an em space at the text cursor: a fixed space as wide as the font size.
cards.script_api: FrameWork.Automation.InvokeItem("ddb00511-a6ae-4430-bcc2-2c09345ec25f") (text edit mode); object model: s.Text.Selection.InsertAfterWide ChrW(8195) (unverified)
use_for: fixed gap between a number and its label in a list
indent-like space before a line's text
avoid: needs an active text cursor (Text tool editing); in a script put the character straight into the string

review.changes: script_api: InsertAfter -> InsertAfterWide (the harvested Unicode variant; fixed spaces and the non-breaking hyphen are outside the ANSI code page InsertAfter works in)

cards.name: En Dash
cards.summary: Inserts an en dash at the text cursor, the dash used between the two ends of a range (dates, times, pages).
cards.script_api: FrameWork.Automation.InvokeItem("2539b9fc-d5ee-460f-a498-405469254c59") (text edit mode); object model: s.Text.Selection.InsertAfterWide ChrW(8211) (unverified)
use_for: date and time ranges on event posters
page or price ranges in a catalogue
avoid: needs an active text cursor (Text tool editing); in a script put the character straight into the string

review.changes: script_api: InsertAfter -> InsertAfterWide (the harvested Unicode variant; fixed spaces and the non-breaking hyphen are outside the ANSI code page InsertAfter works in)

cards.name: En Space
cards.summary: Inserts an en space at the text cursor: a fixed space half as wide as the font size.
cards.script_api: FrameWork.Automation.InvokeItem("25874021-a162-43f5-bb52-122386f7b586") (text edit mode); object model: s.Text.Selection.InsertAfterWide ChrW(8194) (unverified)
use_for: consistent gap between a bullet character and text
aligning figures in short lists
avoid: needs an active text cursor (Text tool editing); in a script put the character straight into the string

review.changes: script_api: InsertAfter -> InsertAfterWide (the harvested Unicode variant; fixed spaces and the non-breaking hyphen are outside the ANSI code page InsertAfter works in)

cards.name: Non-breaking Hyphen
cards.summary: Inserts a hyphen that never breaks across lines, keeping hyphenated words or numbers on one line.
cards.script_api: FrameWork.Automation.InvokeItem("9445e179-5cce-4c90-87ab-6402bf0d4d25") (text edit mode); object model: s.Text.Selection.InsertAfterWide ChrW(8209) (unverified)
use_for: keep phone numbers like 011-2345 together
keep a hyphenated brand name on one line
avoid: some fonts lack the non-breaking hyphen glyph; check the result in the chosen font

review.changes: script_api: InsertAfter -> InsertAfterWide (the harvested Unicode variant; fixed spaces and the non-breaking hyphen are outside the ANSI code page InsertAfter works in)

cards.name: Non-breaking Space
cards.summary: Inserts a space that never allows a line break, keeping the words on either side together.
cards.script_api: FrameWork.Automation.InvokeItem("c548b8e9-fa9b-4204-a1b0-395794d19f73") (text edit mode); object model: s.Text.Selection.InsertAfterWide ChrW(160) (unverified)
use_for: keep values and units together (10 kg)
keep a name and initial on one line in a headline
avoid: needs an active text cursor (Text tool editing); in a script put the character straight into the string

use_for: control where a long word breaks in narrow justified columns
tidy rag in a tight paragraph
avoid: needs an active text cursor (Text tool editing); in a script put the character straight into the string

use_for: price lists with aligned columns
leader-dot menus and tables of contents
avoid: needs an active text cursor (Text tool editing); in a script put the character straight into the string

small fixed gap before a unit or symbol

cards.name: Line-Breaking Rules
cards.summary: Opens Line-Breaking Rules, the Asian (CJK) typesetting rules: which characters may not start a line, may not end a line, and may overflow the margin.
cards.how: Tick and edit the Leading characters, Following characters and Overflow characters lists; Reset restores the defaults. The command is shown only when Asian text support is enabled.
cards.script_api: FrameWork.Automation.InvokeItem("4d4a7f3c-6767-4d2d-96f3-cf44e6acfdb7") opens the dialog only; no object-model call for this job is known
use_for: Japanese or Chinese packaging copy where punctuation must not start a line
CJK body text that should follow local line-break conventions
avoid: no practical effect on Latin-script layout; use non-breaking spaces or hyphens there

cards.name: Make Text Web-compatible
cards.summary: Toggle: marks the selected paragraph text as web-compatible (HTML) text, so it stays live, selectable text when the drawing is exported as an HTML page; CorelDRAW 2024 still installs its HTML (.htm/.html) filter.
cards.script_api: FrameWork.Automation.InvokeItem("e4f6d170-9b87-49ff-8a86-000ac07e7ca4"); object model: s.Text.MakeHTMLCompatible(True) (unverified)
use_for: legacy HTML page output where body copy must stay selectable and searchable
avoid: adds nothing for print or PDF work; PDF export keeps text as text anyway

review.changes: summary: replaced the 'unsure whether 2024 still has an HTML route' hedge; the installed filters.ini registers an HTM filter (*.htm;*.html, IEHTML.flt); confidence low -> medium

cards.name: Create Empty Text Frame
cards.path: Text/Paragraph Text Frame/Create Empty Text Frame
cards.summary: Places an empty paragraph text frame inside the selected closed object, shaped like it, ready for typed or pasted text that flows inside the shape.
cards.script_api: FrameWork.Automation.InvokeItem("886e12c9-7163-4881-8002-804a9a215019")
use_for: copy filling a circle or badge shape
body text flowing inside a custom silhouette
avoid: for a plain rectangular block just drag a frame with the Text tool

cards.name: Fit Text To Frame
cards.path: Text/Paragraph Text Frame/Fit Text To Frame
cards.summary: Scales the size of the text in the selected paragraph text frame up or down so the text exactly fills the frame without overflowing.
cards.script_api: FrameWork.Automation.InvokeItem("e1b67386-f0f9-413b-82a7-bbe484073c55"); object model: s.Text.FitTextToFrame (unverified)
use_for: make a tagline fill a fixed box in a template
cure overflow in a fixed-size label
avoid: gives odd fractional point sizes that differ between frames; for consistent typography set sizes by hand or through styles
